classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small (~71 aa) de novo soluble protein candidate using ESM3, QC the sequence composition and biophysical properties, independently predict the 3-D structure with Protenix v2, perform per-residue structural analysis, and produce a ranked candidate summary.
assumptions: Seed sequence is a 71-residue helix-repeat scaffold (AEAAAK repeats); ESM3 co-generates a novel sequence and structure trace while preserving helical character at temperature 0.5.
ESM3 is run with tracks=[sequence, structure] so the executor can materialise a Protenix-format input JSON from the generated sequence before handing off to protenix_v2.
Protenix v2 is run in fast QC mode (n_sample=1, n_cycle=10, no MSA, no templates) — one seed is sufficient to obtain per-residue pLDDT and PAE for ranking.
sequence_analysis provides a solubility proxy via net charge, instability index, and composition fractions; no dedicated in-silico solubility predictor is available among the selected tools.
rank_designs is called with top_k=1 because only one candidate is produced; the output nonetheless contains the full scored record for downstream submission decisions.
No fold-class, functional-site, length, or solubility-target constraints were supplied; a ~71 aa helical bundle default is assumed and recorded here rather than in missing_inputs.
No negative-design or hallucination-avoidance criteria were specified; sequence novelty relative to the seed is the only diversity check.
missing_inputs: No explicit target length, fold class, or functional-site constraints provided — defaulting to ~71 aa helical bundle seed.
No reference template or GO-term scope supplied; proceeding without homology anchoring.
No solubility, thermostability, or expression-host targets specified; QC relies on compositional proxies only.

success_criteria.candidate_generated: esm3 returns a novel amino-acid sequence distinct from the seed with an accompanying structure track
success_criteria.sequence_qc_passed: sequence_analysis returns net charge at pH 7.4, instability index, and per-region composition for the generated sequence
success_criteria.structure_predicted: protenix_v2 returns at least one predicted structure with per-residue pLDDT and a global confidence score
success_criteria.structure_analyzed: structure_analysis returns per-residue RSA, secondary-structure assignment, contact counts, and any liability flags
success_criteria.ranking_complete: rank_designs returns a ranked record table with at least one candidate scored against all upstream evidence
